why: every family holding unjudged cells is in this hour's queue at its own quota
rule: floor first (an equal share of 25% of measured capacity to every family holding backlog), then the remainder in proportion to backlog; the docket ships whole, interleaved, so every prefix the judge's budget reaches is family-balanced

discovered.judging_reason: family 'discovered' is banned from live capital (mt5desk/live_policy.py DEFAULT_BANNED_FAMILIES) and refused at both live doors, so it cannot reach the book even if it passes and is given no share of the scarce judge. Mining is unrestricted; the rows are kept in data/hypotheses/study_bank.json

realised_pass_rate_rule: counted from gate_verdict_ledger.jsonl every pass, so no cursor can make it stale; terminal_gate UNKNOWN is the sealed judge's UNMEASURED path and counts toward neither judged nor passed, because nobody looked is not a failure

never_fires_days_0.route: the spec never fired on bars that ARE present -- upstream, to the compiler that mints it; nothing to convert, no bars are missing

too_rare_1_to_59_days.route: fires too rarely for CPCV's 60 observations -- a fact about the search, recorded as `unmeasured` in the priors so it moves no pass probability (nobody looked; that is not evidence against the edge)

unknown_reasons.why_unknown: external_gauntlet emits no `terminal_gate` on its UNMEASURED branch and _append_gate_ledger defaults that to UNKNOWN; the judge is sealed, so this is named here rather than fixed there

build_input_probe.rule: a never-judged cell whose build provably refuses for want of a named input absent on this host is parked by name and re-admitted the pass that input is present; anything the probe cannot prove goes to the judge as before

keff_order.rule: priority = delta_N_eff(symbol; worse sign, exposure_neff on the desk's daily panel) + 1.0 if the cell's alpha cluster is empty in the book + declared orthogonality if its census class is vacant. REORDER ONLY: read inside each family stream after never-judged and unseen-mechanism, and as a one-sided family factor 1+max(0, mean) on the remainder; no row dropped
keff_order.vacant_classes_why: 23 census class(es) at orthogonality >= 0.35 hold none of 1680 certified/traded names

instrument.why: book of 99 instrument(s), nominal 457; 134 of 134 docket symbols measured

value_rule: remainder after every family's floor goes down expected value per judge-second: p_optimistic (upper credible bound of the desk's own Beta prior, so an unseen family is explored) x net-of-cost slot value (NET_EDGE.json) x (1 + marginal breadth from EFFECTIVE_BREADTH cluster occupancy) x keff_factor (1 + max(0, mean marginal-k_eff priority of the family's cells, research/docket_keff.py)), divided by measured seconds per cell x the family's bar cost

banned_routed_out.why: a family banned from live capital cannot reach the book even if it passes, so the scarce judge is not spent on it; mining stays unrestricted and the rows are kept, never deleted

build_input_parked_trials.rule: rows parked as build_input_missing stay in the trial census (effective_trials reads them beside the docket): parking moves no charge

never_fire_ground.rule: a (family, symbol) with this many parked never-firing cells and no verdict with a named gate ranks after every other row; nothing dropped

fireability.rule: a row whose family's own input guard returns no signal on the inputs the judge would hand it ranks after every other row; nothing dropped, nothing skipped, every row still judged and counted by the sealed judge in its turn

variant_demotion.rule: a parameter variant of a rule already queued on the same family, symbol and horizon ranks below an unseen mechanism inside its own family stream. The queue is uncapped and no row is dropped; only the order changes

family_demotion.rule: the first claim of an L2 hypothesis family (same rule, co-moving instruments) ranks ahead of later members inside its family stream, after the variant test. Nothing dropped, nothing inherited, every cell judged and counted; only the order changes
